That sounds like a plan! I'm looking forward to it. Have you had breakfast yet?
I've already had breakfast. I made some toast and had a cup of coffee before leaving my room. It's always nice to start the day with a good meal.
That's great! I had a quick breakfast too before leaving my room. It gives me enough energy to get through the morning. Have you checked the weather for today?
I haven't checked yet. But it's always a good idea to be prepared for any weather. Let's hope for a nice day! Have you got everything you need for work today?
I have my bag with all my essentials for work. Let's catch up more at Hobbs Cafe! See you there.
See you at Hobbs Cafe, Dolores! Have a great day!
